# PCSS II Robotics (FTC Team #23548)

> Pioneer Charter School of Science II Robotics is a 501(c)(3) non-profit student-led competitive robotics organization in Saugus, Massachusetts.

## Core Identity & Details
- Organization: PCSS II Robotics (Pioneer Charter School of Science II)
- FTC Team Number: #23548
- Tax Status: 501(c)(3) Non-Profit Public Charity (Tax-Deductible Contributions)
- Location: Saugus, Massachusetts (Serving Essex County & North Shore)
- Contact Email: robotics@pcss2.org
- Official Website: https://www.pcssiirobotics.org

## Competitive Programs
- FIRST Tech Challenge (FTC): High school division engineering, custom CAD (Onshape / SolidWorks), mecanum & odometry chassis design, and Java autonomous pathing with RoadRunner.
- VEX & FLL Mentorship: Feeder programs for middle and elementary school students.

## FTC Robot Engineering Specifications
- 2025-2026 Season (INTO THE DEEP): Kraken V2 — 4x REV HD Hex Mecanum Drivetrain with Pinpoint Odometry, active compliant roller intake, high-speed specimen elevator, 500Hz optical telemetry with OpenCV color sorting.
- 2024-2025 Season (CENTERSTAGE): AeroStrike — 2+4 Pixel Auto, paper drone launcher, HuskyLens AI AprilTag vision system.
- 2023-2024 Season (POWERPLAY): Vortex — High-reach 33-inch telescopic linear slide, AprilTag autonomous signal decoder.

## Corporate Sponsorship & 501(c)(3) Partnership Tiers
- Title / Platinum ($5,000+): Primary logo on robot & banner, VIP competition pit access, social media spotlight, tax receipt & W-9.
- Gold ($2,500+): Large logo on robot, team shirt, booth space at STEM events.
- Silver ($1,000+): Medium logo on website, pit banner, team shirt.
- Bronze ($500+): Website logo & team shirt mention.
- In-Kind Contributions: CNC tooling, raw aluminum, 3D printing filament, motors & control electronics.

## Key Events & Flagship Tournaments
- Circuit 2026 Flagship Showcase: Regional STEM Expo & State Qualifier (Spring 2026)
- FTC Massachusetts Regionals: Winter competition qualifiers
- Community Scrapyard Build Workshops & JPL Mentorship Days
